moments.title: Green Man Festival Kicks Off!
moments.blurb: The beloved Green Man Festival is underway in the Brecon Beacons, Wales, featuring Mogwai, Wilco, Four Tet, and Wolf Alice among its headliners until Sunday.

angles.name: Live from the Beacons
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is officially ON! Who are you most excited to see in the beautiful Brecon Beacons this weekend? Let us know!

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: It's a huge weekend for music lovers as Green Man Festival brings indie, rock, and folk to Wales. Mogwai, Wilco, Four Tet, Wolf Alice headlining – what a lineup!

angles.name: Wales' Big Weekend
angles.copy: The Brecon Beacons are buzzing! Green Man Festival is here, bringing incredible music and arts to our doorstep until Sunday. Who's heading down?

moments.title: F1 Dutch Grand Prix: The Final Lap
moments.blurb: Formula 1 heads to Zandvoort for the Dutch Grand Prix this weekend (Aug 21-23), marking its final race under the current contract and featuring the first-ever F1 Sprint at the circuit.

angles.name: Race Weekend Alert
angles.copy: Lights out and away we go! The Dutch Grand Prix is this weekend, and it's set to be a big one – the last F1 race at Zandvoort under its current deal. Who are you backing for the win?

angles.name: F1 Sprint Debut
angles.copy: History in the making at Zandvoort! This weekend's Dutch Grand Prix includes the circuit's first-ever F1 Sprint. Expect high drama from Friday to Sunday.

moments.title: Happy 31st Birthday, Dua Lipa!
moments.blurb: British pop sensation Dua Lipa, known for hits like 'New Rules' and 'Levitating', celebrates her 31st birthday on Saturday, August 22nd.

angles.name: Pop Superstar Turns 31
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 31st birthday to the incredible Dua Lipa this Saturday! What's your favourite track from the 'Future Nostalgia' queen?

angles.name: Dua Lipa's Big Day
angles.copy: It's Dua Lipa's birthday on Saturday – the pop powerhouse turns 31! Get ready to dance into the weekend with some of her biggest bangers.

moments.title: Happy 48th Birthday, James Corden!
moments.blurb: English actor, comedian, and TV host James Corden, known for 'Gavin & Stacey' and 'The Late Late Show', turns 48 on Saturday, August 22nd.

angles.name: Corden's 48th
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the one and only James Corden, who turns 48 this Saturday! From Barry Island to Carpool Karaoke, what's your favourite James Corden moment?

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gav & Stacey Star
angles.copy: Saturday sees James Corden celebrate his 48th birthday! The star of Gavin & Stacey and former Late Late Show host has certainly made his mark on entertainment.

moments.title: Happy 38th Birthday, Rupert Grint!

angles.name: Ron Weasley Turns 38
angles.copy: Mischief managed! Wishing a magical 38th birthday to Rupert Grint on Monday. What's your favourite Ron Weasley line from the Harry Potter films?

angles.name: Harry Potter Star's Birthday
angles.copy: Can you believe Rupert Grint is turning 38 on Monday? Our favourite ginger wizard has certainly grown up! Let's celebrate!

moments.title: Happy 61st Birthday, Shania Twain!

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop's 61st
angles.copy: That *does* impress us much! Happy 61st birthday to the legendary Shania Twain this Friday. What's your ultimate Shania anthem?

angles.name: Shania's Big Day
angles.copy: Get ready to sing along! Shania Twain turns 61 on Friday, August 28th. We're celebrating the enduring legacy of a true music icon.

moments.title: Happy 40th Birthday, Florence Welch!
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the enigmatic frontwoman of Florence + The Machine, celebrates her 40th birthday on Friday, August 28th.

angles.name: Florence Turns 40
angles.copy: Happy 40th birthday to the incredible Florence Welch this Friday! The voice of Florence + The Machine has given us so many powerful tracks. Which one's your favourite?

angles.name: A Decade of Florence + The Machine
angles.copy: Celebrating Florence Welch's 40th this Friday! From 'Lungs' to 'Dance Fever', she's been a unique force in music for over a decade.

moments.title: Happy 54th Birthday, Cameron Diaz!

angles.name: Iconic Actress Turns 54
angles.copy: From 'The Mask' to 'Charlie's Angels', Cameron Diaz has graced our screens for decades. She celebrates her 54th birthday this Sunday, August 30th!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend Approaching
moments.blurb: The Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, marking a long weekend and the unofficial end of the summer season for many.

angles.name: Long Weekend Countdown
angles.copy: The countdown is on! England, Wales & Northern Ireland get their Summer Bank Holiday on Monday, August 31st. How are you planning to spend your long weekend?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: It's almost time for the last Bank Holiday of summer on August 31st! Make the most of it before the autumn vibes truly kick in. What are your plans?

angles.name: Devon's Bank Holiday Plans
angles.copy: Devon, get ready for a long weekend! The Summer Bank Holiday is on Monday, August 31st. What local spots are you heading to?
